name: long-horizon
title_zh: 跨会话接着干的长期任务台，每次留下证据和纠正
tagline_zh: 定时唤醒的 Agent 常常忘掉上次做到哪、为什么那么做。它把每次行动、证据、被纠正的地方落成可读记录。
tagline_en: Scheduled agents forget where they stopped and why. This keeps actions, evidence, and corrections on disk so the.
desc_en: Set up and pursue autonomous responsibilities across scheduled sessions, preserving actions, evidence, and corrections so later agents can continue and learn.
why_zh: 把「责任」当成跨会话的持久对象：行动、依据、人工纠正分开存，后来者能追溯也能改判，而不是每轮从零重猜。
why_en: Treats a responsibility as a persistent object: actions, evidence, and human corrections stored apart, so later agents can trace.
limit_zh: 它只管跨会话的记账与续跑，不替你调度定时器、不发通知、不做权限隔离；没有可写的持久目录就退化成普通单次任务。
limit_en: Only handles cross-session bookkeeping and resumption — no scheduler, no notifications, no permission isolation; without a writable persistent dir.
title_en: A long-horizon task desk that resumes across sessions
